paras: At the Valley of Kings, Thorvald Deepforge arms travelers bound for Loch Modan. He helps defend the pass between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan.

Thorvald Deepforge supplies weapons at the Valley of Kings. Troggs and roaming wildlife threaten the mountain passes between Khaz Modan's interior and its outlying lands. Travelers from Dun Morogh and those heading deeper into Loch Modan can find blades and axes here to defend dwarven lands.
